arguments.question: Across ANET, QQQ, MU, META and NVDA, assess neutral 21/63-session macro and policy transmission channels using the fixed SPY/IWM/HYG context and available FRED/Fed materials: rates/financial conditions, AI-capex sensitivity, and any policy uncertainty that could alter broad growth-equity multiples or demand. Cite evidence IDs, distinguish facts from inferences, and stop after the seeded macro series plus one material Fed document if needed.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether a shared macro regime could dominate issuer-specific catalysts and supports conditional, rather than calibrated, valuation/multiple assumptions.
